ROW2: 5 headless armless legless torso+pelvis only. Front white short-sleeve shirt core with small front neck opening, green ribbed haramaki and dark pants pelvis. All limbs drawn neutral relaxed near-straight, front view consistently; arms each single clean part, pant legs show soft full black trousers including hips/knees/ankles, boots NOT embedded in legs. High-quality crisp anime chibi cel shading matching references, consistent outline/detail/color. In actual rig assembly head/torso/hands and feet need overlap, so extend complete hidden roots. Do not draw assembled characters. Never mirror a different direction; preserve anatomical asymmetric accessories. True alpha, no checkerboard.
